title: Finance Swarm Agent
description: A sophisticated multi-agent system that uses swarm intelligence to analyze financial data, generate investment strategies, and provide market insights

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Implements swarm intelligence for collaborative financial analysis and decision-making
Integrates with financial data sources like yfinance for real-time market data
Features specialized agents for market analysis, strategy generation, and risk assessment
Uses consensus mechanisms to aggregate insights from multiple agents
Provides comprehensive portfolio optimization and investment recommendations
